jech/dht vendored from https://github.com/jech/dht
Upstream commit: 0bbb8f4a5bd914b60de5e9fbb51573aa33a1cf18
Retrieved: 2026-07-16
License: MIT (see LICENCE)

The reference mainline BitTorrent DHT (Kademlia, BEP-5) by Juliusz Chroboczek —
the same implementation Transmission uses. Only the two sources needed to build
the library are vendored (dht.c, dht.h) plus LICENCE and README. The upstream
build files (Makefile, dht-example.c) are not vendored — GMCA builds dht.c through
torrent/CMakeLists.txt instead. No source file was modified.

This revision routes every outgoing datagram through the user-provided dht_sendto
callback (dht.h) and never touches the socket fd directly — it only stores the fd
as an opaque token and hands it back to dht_sendto. Reception is entirely the
caller's job (feed datagrams to dht_periodic). GMCA therefore wires both I/O
directions through torrent::net::UdpSocket (the platform shim), so dht.c compiles
and runs unmodified on every target — the raw-fd portability caveat of older
jech/dht revisions does not apply here.
